title: Locations
description: Your practices, with their time zone and opening hours

help.title: About locations
help.overview: Locations are your practices. Each has its own time zone and opening hours; dentists' working hours there are limited to them.

sections.title: On this page
items: Set the IANA time zone (for example Europe/Zurich) so appointments stay correct across daylight-saving changes.
Add closed days for holidays; nobody can be booked there on them.
A location with appointments can't be deleted; deactivate it instead.
